# `TEXT_LINE_MISMATCH`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | warning |
| Area | [Text (`TEXT_`)](README.md#domain-text) |
| Reported by | `plugin` |

## What happened

Figma wraps the text into a different number of lines than the browser, even after buffering.

## What to do

Switch that text to locked-lines mode, or check that the font matches (see `FONT_*`).
